Product Management Intern

Location: Waterloo, ON
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
Work Term: Summer 2027
Duration: 4 months
Salary: $27.50 per hour
Application Deadline: 2027-01-30

About the Role

We are a small team building scheduling software for dental clinics. Marblehead Software is looking for a Product Management Intern to support roadmap research and release planning for our clinic scheduling product.

What You Will Do

- Support roadmap planning and backlog grooming with the product owner
- Run user research interviews with clinic administrators
- Write product requirements and acceptance criteria

What You Bring

- Enrolled in a business, engineering, or design program
